headline: Neurocrine Biosciences Beats Q3 2026 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Neurocrine Biosciences beat third-quarter 2026 earnings expectations by $1.38 and topped revenue estimates, sending shares higher after hours.
why: Neurocrine Biosciences is a biopharmaceutical company focused on neurological and endocrine-related diseases, making its quarterly earnings a key indicator of financial health for biotech investors.

impacts.name: Neurocrine Biosciences
impacts.why: Beating consensus earnings and revenue estimates directly drives positive after-hours share price movement.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
